name: repurpose-content
summary: Turn an existing source artifact into derivative outputs while preserving evidence, context, and approval boundaries.
approval_gates: vault_write: follow harness/policies/approvals.md before editing vault files unless already authorized
external_read: ask before reading external websites or sources
external_mutation: out of scope; posting, sending, scheduling, or publishing requires a separate workflow
done_when: source artifact is identified and inspected
target channels and target skills are explicit
derivative outputs are returned or saved to an approved path
source map preserves evidence labels and caveats
writing-quality-gate has passed or is explicitly deferred with reason
verification: verify claim-check runs when material claims are reused or compressed
verify derivative outputs do not strengthen unsupported claims
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter if files are edited
